description: Read your connected account's recent conversations, incremental by `since`/`cursor`. Costs $0.0012 per read; billing turns on with the messaging go-live switch (free until then). Requires a connected account. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

since.description: Read only what changed after this value from a previous read.

name: messages_list
title: List Conversations
